Dear Ariad Team,

I am excited to apply for the Social Media Manager position with your client, a global leader in consumer electronics. As a junior digital marketer with a technical edge in SEO and content, I have developed a comprehensive skill set that aligns well with the responsibilities of this role.

Currently, at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted blog content, and build WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. This hands-on experience has honed my ability to create engaging content and optimize it for performance. I am also responsible for tracking site performance using tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, and Ahrefs, which has sharpened my analytical skills—essential for monitoring social media KPIs.

My personal project, mirook.com, showcases my initiative and creativity. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a youth chess champion, integrating social media channels like Instagram and Facebook. I implemented structured data and technical SEO audits to improve visibility, demonstrating my ability to think strategically about online presence.

I am passionate about social media and understand the importance of platform dynamics and trends. I am eager to bring my proactive mindset and stakeholder management skills to coordinate cross-channel campaigns and collaborate with agencies. My affinity for consumer technology and curiosity for digital innovation make me a great fit for this role.

I am confident that my blend of technical and creative skills will contribute to your client's social media success. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
